question: At the same physical drawer width, does showing the opposite width in both cameras for four policy queries change the first task contact compared with a single query?
assignment: Re-render the current host pose on a detached copy for the first four queries. Self uses those two matching images as its sham. Exchange both images for one or four queries, returning to live images after the scheduled count or at the first query following any gripper contact with a drawer or bowl. Keep arm, objects, cameras, all other bodies, proprioception, instruction and random keys matched at the intervention. Only the selected drawer slide in the render copy takes the opposite width of that posture. Compare exact native inputs with each self rendering, the first host/donor images with the previous study, and host physics before and after rendering.
cohort: All four host states in layout 2 at the same bowl and plate positions, two returned postures, eight paired policy seeds at offset 32, two separate model loads in reverse execution order. Twelve conditions per posture and seed, 384 full native trajectories. All receive 540 native downstream controls at 20 Hz with five controls per query. Times to first contact and first placement are measured from policy onset and also reported on the 15/30 s clock which includes the 3 s return.
render_check: Before inference, require an exact match for both self cameras. If a GPU raster differs, keep hashes and pixel counts for each attempt. Retry the detached render up to four times per native observation and, if needed, reacquire the native cameras up to twice on the same physics and proprioception. Stop the run if no exact pair matches; retain all prespecified seeds. Only the matched native and donor images may be submitted.
outcomes: Pair self, one and four in each host state on posture, seed and load. Compare all first 20 executed controls in four five-control chunks by equality and largest absolute component difference. Record first drawer-or-bowl gripper contact identity and control, first containment in each drawer and first containment in any drawer, destination at 15 and 30 seconds including none. Report signed paired contact and first-placement time differences among observed event pairs and both directions of contact and destination changes. Keep all trials and any early cut-offs.
interpretation: For each drawer and direction, count cases in which four queries shift first contact from the one-query host-like target toward the opposite-width sham target. Require a majority of all eight paired seeds within each posture by load cell for a consistent contact reversal on these starts. Score timing and destination separately, even when contact is unaltered. Exact receipt checks and physical command replay are distinct from replication across policy loads.
